findings.note: emit_pressure_state returned cycle_snapshot_promoted=false for the ninth consecutive tick. Dispatcher wrote docs/data/cycle-snapshot-06:32.json for nominal tick 06:30 (offset +2min, sixth consecutive nonzero offset). The promoter looks the file up by nominal tick, the writer names it by wall clock at write. cycle-snapshot-latest.json still carries .tick = 00:00 while every writer emits a full ISO instant.

Root cause located in source rather than inferred from agent narration. .claude/skills/cycle-bootstrap/SKILL.md Step -1 defines the lookup as: TICK = current UTC time formatted as HH:MM (round to nearest 5-min slot, e.g. 02:05 to 02:05). That single line gives two contradictory instructions - format the current time, and round it to a 5-minute slot - and its worked example demonstrates no rounding at all, mapping 02:05 onto itself. It is ambiguous prose interpreted freshly by an LLM on every run, which is why five measured runs show three different lookup behaviours: c216 looked up the NOMINAL TICK 05:45, c218 looked up its READ-TIME MINUTE 06:18, and c219 hit 06:32 from a read at about 06:33, matching neither rule. Measured outcome across six cycles: four hits (05:17, 05:33, 06:02, 06:32) and two misses (05:48 present but rejected, 06:17 present but rejected). Two earlier mechanistic models filed by this dispatcher - a random directory scan, then an exact-minute race - were each falsified by the next observation; no behavioural model is asserted here. The fix does not require knowing which interpretation a given run picks: replace the prose with one unambiguous key, the nominal tick floor(minute/15)*15, computed identically by writer, promoter and consumer, with the consumer taking it from the scheduled_utc token already present in its spawn prompt. Two further defects in the same file: the documented 5-minute grid is unsatisfiable regardless of interpretation, since 0 of 35 snapshot filenames on disk carry a 5-min-aligned minute; and Step -1 still carries a stale note claiming the snapshot writer is a future task that has not landed, so Step -1 will always miss - the writer landed and has written on every tick today. Zone .claude/skills/cycle-bootstrap/ to agent-father.
